parameters.query: UPDATE crawl_frontier SET status='pending', next_crawl_at = NOW() + INTERVAL '1 day' WHERE url = $1

INSERT INTO pages (url, title, text, outgoing, crawled_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, NOW()) ON CONFLICT (url) DO UPDATE SET title=EXCLUDED.title, text=EXCLUDED.text, outgoing=EXCLUDED.outgoing, crawled_at=NOW()
INSERT INTO crawl_frontier (url, status, priority, next_crawl_at) SELECT unnest($1::text[]), 'pending', 1, NOW() + INTERVAL '1 day' ON CONFLICT (url) DO NOTHING
SELECT from_url, to_url, internal FROM links LIMIT 50000

INSERT INTO page_scores (url, pagerank, in_links, domain_authority, orphan, dead_end, spam, updated_at) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,NOW()) ON CONFLICT (url) DO UPDATE SET pagerank=EXCLUDED.pagerank, in_links=EXCLUDED.in_links, domain_authority=EXCLUDED.domain_authority, orphan=EXCLUDED.orphan, dead_end=EXCLUDED.dead_end, spam=EXCLUDED.spam, updated_at=NOW()

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM documents) AS documents, (SELECT count(*) FROM pages) AS pages, (SELECT count(*) FROM crawl_frontier WHERE status='pending') AS pending_urls, (SELECT count(*) FROM error_log WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '15 minutes') AS recent_errors
INSERT INTO metrics (documents, pages, pending_urls, recent_errors, redis_up, created_at) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,NOW())
